about: What coverage-guided generation of conditions still reached with the other round 17 files pending, chosen greedily so that each probe adds behaviours no other one reaches. Mostly a GENERAL PIP that fails (status 404 or 500, or a body that is a number or a boolean) on the right of the collection operators beside each type on the left, and bare null (the attribute resource.null, absent here) on the right of an empty wildcard selection and of an index past the end. Where the OR probe ends, a DENY rule twin tells an ended rule (true) from a failed decision (false).
